thread:
morgan_pm: Quick sync  PredictEmbed GA acceptance checklist  need: final SLA numbers, what goes public vs internal, docs + migration notes, pricing bands, monitoring + quality checks, and rollout owners. Who can take what? :clipboard:

lara_prod: I'll own SLA proposal and customer-facing summary. Draft numbers: p50 < 50ms, p95 < 180ms, sustained error-rate < 0.08%. These are tighter than beta but allow for cold-starts. Suggest public summary only (no credits in public doc).

ravi_sre: For incidenting we want these alerts: p95 > 220ms for 5m, error-rate > 0.15% for 3m, synthetic-smoke failing 3/5 checks. Page P0 to ml-inference if synthetic fails AND error-rate > 0.2%. Owner: ravi_sre.

tom_finops: Pricing input: propose bigger PLG trial to drive adoption: 20k tokens/day free for first 30 days per account, then pay-as-you-go tiers: 0-1M tokens $0.0008/token, 1M-10M $0.0006/token, >10M negotiate. Committed capacity discount: 25% off list. Need infra cost curve to finalize. Owner: tom_finops.

jenna_docs: Docs checklist: public quickstart (JS/Python), API reference (param table), migration note for quantized vs full-precision models, SLA summary page, troubleshooting runbook (common errors + remediation), and sample TF-IDF comparison script for customers migrating from legacy embeddings. I need sample SDK calls + feature-flag details. Owner: jenna_docs.

deploy-bot: Canary plan scheduled: weekday ramp only. Schedule: day0 3% -> day2 15% -> day4 40% -> day7 100%. Automated rollback if any P0 pages or synthetic failing >2m. Canary windows 10:00-16:00 local infra.

legal-bot: Enterprise SLA clause: uptime credits only after 2x violation in a 30-day window; confidentiality + indemnity sections need sign-off. I'll queue for legal review once SLA draft exists.

data-qa: Quality alert proposal: monitor embedding drift using labeled anchors. Trigger metric: mean cosine similarity drop > 0.03 vs baseline over 1h -> ticket to model-quality team. Also surface top 20 lowest-sim pairs in the alert. Owner: data-qa.

morgan_pm: Nice. A couple outstanding asks: 1) analytics queries + Grafana examples for docs 2) confirmation whether public SLA includes measurement windows 3) decision on feature-flag default for quantized fallback.

lara_prod: Measurement windows: rolling 30d for SLO reporting, 5m for operational alerts. Public SLA will show targets and a short note about measurement windows; enterprise full text will include exclusions (maintenance windows, customer misconfiguration).

ravi_sre: Grafana snippets (InfluxQL-like): ```
// p95 latency
SELECT percentile("latency_ms",95) FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v1' AND $timeFilter
// error rate over window
SELECT sum("errors")/sum("requests") FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v1' AND $timeFilter
```

jenna_docs: For the quantized fallback, we'd like an opt-out header `X-Prefer-Exact: 1` + account-level flag in console. Default: allow fallback (safer for latency/cost). I'll document both.

tom_finops: Confirmed default fallback allowed. We should list deterministic customers and add a waiver workflow for dedicated contracts.

morgan_pm: Action items (owners + due dates): Lara: SLA draft + public summary (48h). Ravi: Grafana queries + alert runbook (24h). Jenna: docs PR skeleton & migration guide (72h). Tom: provisional pricing bands (72h). Data-qa: evaluation alert test harness (4 days). Deploy-bot/anya: finalize canary automation & smoke tests (5 days). Legal-bot: queue SLA review after Lara submits.

ravi_sre: Adding one more op ask: add a synthetic endpoint that returns 5 deterministic vectors for quick health checks (helps SLOs). Will add to canary smoke.

lara_prod: I'll include the synthetic contract in the SLA appendix.

jenna_docs: I'll craft the quickstart with the synthetic check example + feature-flag snippet. Example cURL: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict-embed -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"test"}'
```

morgan_pm: If no one objects we'll lock the public SLO numbers and rollout cadence by EOD tomorrow. Any objections?

tom_finops: No objections from finops.

legal-bot: No objections; legal review pending SLA draft.

morgan_pm: Great. I'll add these to the GA board and ping owners. Reminder set for 6121234700 to check progress.
